 Lightning at Avalanche projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 23, 2026 
 Link copied 
 LIGHTNING (7-2-0) at AVALANCHE (5-4-1) 
 9 p.m. ET; The Spot, ALT, SN360, TVAS 
 Lightning projected lineup 
 Brandon Hagel -- Anthony Cirelli -- Nikita Kucherov
 Gage Goncalves-- Brayden Point -- Jake Guentzel
 Ilya Mikheyev -- Zemgus Girgensons -- Pontus Holmberg
 Jeffrey Viel -- Conor Geekie -- Dominic James
 J.J. Moser -- John Carlson
 Ryan McDonagh -- Erik Cernak
 Victor Hedman -- Max Crozier
 Andrei Vasilevskiy
 Dennis Hildeby
 Scratched: Scott Sabourin, Charle-Edouard D'Astous, Emil Lilleberg 
 Injured: Yanni Gourde (hip) 
 Avalanche projected lineup 
 Artturi Lehkonen -- Nathan MacKinnon -- Martin Necas
 Gabriel Landeskog -- Brock Nelson -- Nazem Kadri
 Jaden Schwartz -- Fedor Svechkov -- T.J. Hughes
 Taylor Makar -- Parker Kelly -- Logan O’Connor
 Devon Toews -- Cale Makar
 Brett Kulak -- Sam Malinski
 Josh Manson -- Brent Burns
 Mackenzie Blackwood
 Scott Wedgewood
 Scratched: Noah Juulsen 
 Injured: Zachary L’Heureux (upper body), Nicolas Roy (lower body) 
 Status report 
 Tampa Bay held an optional morning skate. … Cirelli will play after the forward left a 6-2 win at the Vegas Golden Knights with an undisclosed injury on Tuesday. ... O’Connor will make his season debut after missing the past 10 games due to a lower-body injury and then the death of his father. … Taylor Makar was recalled from Colorado of the American Hockey League on Friday; the forward will make his season debut. … Roy, a forward who is day to day, participated in the Avalanche morning skate wearing a non-contact jersey.
